subject: Acme Fintech - Procurement & Vendor Onboarding Follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@acme-fintech.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme Fintech - Procurement & Vendor Onboarding Follow-up

Hi Asha / Carlos 

Thanks again for your time today  really appreciated the candid conversation about Acme's production timeline and procurement requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Economic buyer / decision criteria
- You mentioned Sanjay Iyer (CFO) will sign off on final commercial terms and vendor selection. Confirmed decision criteria: unit cost, latency SLA, and SOC2+/audit controls.

2) Security & Legal checklist
- You asked for SOC 2 Type II report, data handling summary, and SAML metadata for SSO. I'll surface the SOC2 and a short security one-pager in the thread.

3) Procurement & vendor onboarding
- We understand Acme uses a vendor portal for onboarding (you sent the link during the call). For PO/invoicing, please confirm remit-to and PO field requirements (bill-to name, tax ID).

4) Timeline
- Your target: pilot in QA by end of October, production by mid-November. Per our discussion, procurement lead time looked like ~2 weeks after receiving completed vendor packet + W9.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
- Ill upload our W9 and banking details for your AP team (attached).
- Neha (cc'd) will own procurement intake and answer billing questions.
- Can you confirm the vendor packet link we should use and who on your side will receive the packet?

Attachments: 20260914-acme-meeting-notes.pdf (meeting notes)

Happy to hop on a quick call with your procurement contact if that helps speed things up.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182



Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Acme Fintech - Procurement & Vendor Onboarding Follow-up

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the clear recap  that matches what we talked about. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- Economic buyer: Yes, Sanjay will be the final signatory. He'll want a one-pager that outlines cost vs expected token/unit economics and the SLA commitments.

- Security/legal: Please send your latest SOC 2 Type II report and a short data handling summary (especially around logs, KV cache, and retention windows). Also, we need SAML metadata for SSO integration into our Okta org. Our security contact is Carlos (cc'd).

- Vendor onboarding: Use our portal: https://acme-fintech.vendorportal.com/forms/12345
  The portal requires: vendor name, W9/Tax docs, banking info (for ACH), and a point of contact for legal queries. 

- PO & invoicing: We operate Net30 for new vendors. Once the vendor packet and W9 are submitted and approved, AP will issue a PO. Typical lead time after submission is ~10 business days. Please attach the W9 and banking document to the portal and also email them to ap@acme-fintech.com.

Ive attached our vendor_packet.pdf for your reference (shows required fields). If you can get us the W9 + ACH info today, Ill start the intake  Ill also loop Sanjay on the one-pager.

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Fintech
asha.rao@acme-fintech.com
Phone: +1 (212) 555-0147

Attachment: Acme_vendor_packet.pdf

Hi Asha 

Thanks for the portal link and timeline. Im Neha (Head of Revenue Ops)  Ill be coordinating the intake and AP items from Redwood's side. A couple quick asks to make sure the portal submission goes smoothly: 

- Can you confirm the remit-to name exactly as it should appear on the PO and the tax ID format you need (EIN/SSN)?
- Our standard payment terms are Net30 but we can discuss alternatives if needed for the pilot.
- Ive attached our W9 and banking stub for upload (Redwood_W9_and_banking.pdf). If the portal also needs a commercial contact, please use Marissa (cc).

Dev (cc)  can you provide the invoice header we should expect to see on the PO (line items, description) so we can map it to our billing system?

If useful, we can submit the packet today and flag it for expedited review.

Regards,

Hi Neha 

Received, thanks. A few confirmations: 
- Remit-to: "Redwood Inference, Inc."  Please include EIN: 12-3456789 on the portal.
- AP prefers PDF attachments in the vendor portal. We will still accept direct email to ap@acme-fintech.com if easier.
- Payment terms: Net30 is fine for the pilot.
- PO timing: Once we have the vendor packet + W9 and the security checklist is acknowledged by our security team, AP will issue a PO in ~10 business days. Well expedite if legal approves early.

Security note: Carlos asked if you can send SAML metadata and a short sequence diagram of what data (if any) flows to the Redwood control plane. That will help speed security sign-off.

Ill start the intake in the portal today and flag it for Sanjays review.

Best,
Asha
